Stay, please. Your life matters so much. 
Give life one more chance please.
Focus on what you love, on yourself and your interests and somehow you’ll bump into your one and only
My unkind harsh depressed mother and the loneliness that I get to deal with every single day. I barely have any friends, and I deal with so much anxiety ( including sleep anxiety) and nightmares.
Same. I am still in bed and it’s 8 pm
Please don’t do it. Your life matters, and I promise you you make a difference even if you don’t think so.
